source_title: AccessAbility Resource Center: Student Accommodation Grievances
section_heading: Failure to accommodate and complaint process
text: For a concern about a disability accommodation, the university encourages informal resolution with the person or department involved when appropriate. If the concern remains unresolved, contact the director of the AccessAbility Resource Center. The director investigates the complaint and suggests solutions. Students may use the formal grievance procedure if the concern remains unresolved.

source_title: AccessAbility Resource Center: Student Accommodation Grievances
text: For an urgent disability-related grievance or an upcoming event, a student can ask the ADA coordinator whether an expedited procedure can be arranged.
